name: shortcut-recorder
title: Shortcut recorder
description: A field that records a key combination: press the keys and see them as keycaps; Escape cancels, Backspace clears and conflicts are named.
docs: value is a combination written the same on every platform, Mod+Shift+K, where Mod is Command on a Mac and Ctrl elsewhere; onValueChange reports the new one, or null when it is cleared. Focusing the field starts recording: the held modifiers show live as keycaps, and the combination is committed when a key that is not a modifier lands. Escape cancels, Backspace or Delete clears, and Tab always moves on, so the field never traps focus; a reminder under the field says so while it records. reserved is a list of combinations that cannot be used, or an object that gives the reason for each; findConflict is given a combination and returns the name of what already uses it. Either one refuses the combination with the reason in words ("Already used by Search"), and requireModifier also refuses a key pressed alone, naming keys the shown keyboard has (needsModifier in messages can be a function of the platform). platform shows the keys of a Mac (⌘ ⇧ ⌥) or of Windows and Linux (Ctrl Shift Alt), and by default is read from the browser after mount. A screen reader hears the shortcut as words ("Command plus Shift plus K"). While it has focus the field listens at the top of the window, so a dialog around it does not close on the Escape that cancels a recording. messages replaces every sentence, and name sends the combination with a plain form.
